source_of_truth: Read by hand: this is the same 'private page with no guard' defect as the straightforward missing-middleware case, but expressed through a different routing shape: a dynamic segment pages/orders/[id].vue whose only route meta is layout: 'secure'. A Vue layout is rendering, not a route guard; the one global middleware present (tenant.global.ts) only sets a tenant header and is not auth-like. So the order-detail page runs with no guard and a correct auditor must report page-without-guard for it (page-without-guard carries no line).

expected.rationale: the page declares only layout: 'secure' and relies on a non-auth global middleware; it has no page middleware and no global auth guard, so the route is unguarded.
